metadata.title: Scalar Curvature Lower Bounds and Convergence in Measure
metadata.abstract: Assume that smooth metrics $g_k$ converge in measure to a smooth metric $g$. Gromov asked the following question: if all the metrics $g_k$ have non-negative scalar curvature does it follow that $g$ also has non-negative scalar curvature? We answer Gromov's question in dimension three. We show that, without further assumptions, the metric $g$ need not have non-negative scalar curvature and in fact $g$ may be completely arbitrary. However, if one assumes in addition that the identity maps $(M,g_k)\to (M,g)$ are uniformly bi-Lipschitz, then indeed $g$ must have non-negative scalar curvature. Our method of proof can also be used to show that, under an almost Euclidean entropy condition, scalar curvature lower bounds will persist under convergence of the metrics together with their inverses in $L^p$ for suitably large $p$.

analysis.progressType: 测度收敛下标曲率的保留与失效
analysis.workSummary: 在三维回答 Gromov 问题：非负标曲率度量依测度收敛时极限可任意；若恒等映射一致双 Lipschitz 则极限保留非负标曲率，并在近 Euclidean 熵条件下讨论度量及逆度量的 Lp 收敛。
analysis.breakthrough: 精准划定弱收敛与几何控制对标量曲率稳定性的作用。
analysis.limitations: 肯定与否定结论的额外假设不能混用；Lp 指数需正文确认。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.priorityReason: 标量曲率在弱极限下的稳定性属于核心几何问题。
